lines.en: We are going to paint the wall. Which color?
lines.ko: 우리 벽을 칠할 거예요. 무슨 색으로 할까요?

lines.en: I like blue, Grandma. Blue is like the sky.
lines.ko: 할머니, 저는 파란색이 좋아요. 하늘 같아요.

lines.en: Blue is nice. Last year the wall was gray.
Can we paint one wall yellow too?
Yellow and blue? That's bright and happy.
What color do you like, Grandma?
I like purple and pink. But white is easy.
lines.ko: 보라색과 분홍색을 좋아해요. 그래도 흰색이 쉬워요.

lines.en: Then let's do white and one blue wall.
lines.ko: 그럼 흰색이랑 파란 벽 하나로 해요.

lines.en: Good. Will you help me paint tomorrow?
Yes! I will hold the blue brush for you.
lines.ko: 네! 제가 파란 붓을 들어 드릴게요.

lines.en: Hi! I love your pink dress.
Thank you. Which color do you like best?
I like brown and gray. They are calm.
When I was young, I only wore red.
Really? Red looks good on you.
Now I like white and black too.
Do you like purple?
Yes! The purple flowers in my garden are beautiful.
lines.ko: 네! 우리 정원의 보라색 꽃들이 아름다워요.

lines.en: Will you show me your garden one day?
Of course. I will show you tomorrow.
